items.question: In what year was the world's first cloned camel, Injaz, created and born in Dubai?
items.fact: World's first cloned camel Injaz born in Dubai in 2009

items.question: What does a UAE citizen have to provide to take part in the Emirati Genome Programme?
items.gold: A single blood sample, given at one of the sample collection sites.
items.fact: Participation requires one blood sample at a collection site
